question: What inner constituents and head regions are included in this protective invocation?
premises: One's own elements, vital breath, power, and self are named.
The parting of the hair is named.
inference: Protection is invoked for one's own elements, breath, power, and self, as well as the hair parting and head.
uncertainties: The compound 'sva-dhātu-prāṇa-śakti-ātma' may be parsed in more than one way.
plain_english: Again, in one's own elements, vital breath, power, and self, in the parting of the hair, and in the head.
